headline: Hustler Fund Receives Ksh5 Billion Boost And Increases Loan Limits
seoTitle: Hustler Fund Receives Ksh5 Billion Boost And Loan Increases
metaDescription: President William Ruto has increased the Hustler Fund lending capacity to KSh150,000 as the government injects an additional KSh5 billion into the program.
aiSummaryBullets: The Kenyan government has allocated an additional KSh5 billion to the Hustler Fund program.
Borrowing limits for participants have been officially raised to a maximum of KSh150,000.
President William Ruto announced the funding injection and the updated loan thresholds to increase access to credit.
aiContextParagraph: The Hustler Fund is a state-backed financial initiative in Kenya designed to provide accessible credit to individuals and small enterprises. Recently, the government moved to strengthen the program by injecting an additional KSh5 billion into the fund. Alongside this financial boost, President William Ruto confirmed that the maximum loan limit available to borrowers has been increased to KSh150,000. These adjustments are intended to expand the reach and capacity of the fund, enabling more citizens to access capital for their financial needs and business operations. By raising the individual borrowing ceilings, the administration aims to improve the effectiveness of the scheme as a tool for economic inclusion. The announcement follows ongoing efforts by the government to sustain the fund's operations and ensure that credit remains available to the public under the updated fiscal framework.
whyItIsViral: The story is being tracked by two independent media outlets following the official announcement of the funding increase.
